_doc: Model ids the server can serve (docs/server.md 1b). --model-id ID picks the first pack of ID's list that is complete; --pack DIR overrides. '@IJAH_PACKS/' = the packs directory (env IJAH_PACKS, default ~/.cache/ijah/packs); download with tools/ijah download base|swift|base-4bit (or hf download SiliconSpecies/<name> --local-dir <IJAH_PACKS>/<name>). A pack with trunk6 metadata is complete when all 48 layers are converted and the bf16 mixer is in. 'drafter': the DFlash2 block drafter the id uses by default (docs/mtp.md 13; Inco's incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2 @ a22a1744e85c, Apache-2.0, trained on the Qwen3.8 base; it drafts Swift-1.5 too): the first path ('@IJAH_DRAFTERS/' = IJAH_DRAFTERS, default ~/.cache/ijah/drafters) holding config.json + model.safetensors (--drafter-path overrides; tools/ijah download drafter); none there -> the MTP head drafts, with one log line; --drafter none (NE_DRAFTER=none) forces the MTP head. 'alias_of': an id that is another id with its drafter required (the -dflash ids, kept for clients configured before v0.2; a 400 when the server runs that model without the drafter). 'in_all': false keeps an id out of --models all.

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-native-4bit._doc: SiliconSpecies/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-EXL3-Ijah-4bit: the T6 pack with Sushi-4bpw's 4-bit routed experts; faster, lower fidelity (the T6 pack is preferred). Its experts differ from T6's, so it shares nothing with the other ids: not in --models all.
